## Overview

An introduction to **Visual Studio Code (VS Code)** and its open-source
alternative **VSCodium**. Both are powerful but beginner-friendly tools that can
make your work easier and more organised. We believe that adopting VS Code or
VSCodium will let you streamline your working environment and standardise tasks
within your working group.

## What you'll learn

- How to install and use helpful extensions
- How to connect to servers with remote SSH
- How to write and format documents in Markdown (Markdown All in One) and Quarto
- How to code in a variety of languages — R, bash, and Python
- How to display different file types: HTML, image previews, and CSVs

## Prerequisites

You are welcome to just come and listen. If you want to code along, please bring
your own laptop with **VS Code** or **VSCodium** installed.
